cultural_issues: The jebena has a handle on the side, which is not traditional for an Ethiopian jebena
The cups have handles, whereas traditional Ethiopian coffee cups (cini) are handleless
The grass on the floor is not a traditional setting for a coffee ceremony, which usually takes place on a mat or rug
artifacts: The hand reaching for the lid has distorted fingers
The hand on the left has an unnatural shape and finger count
The coffee pot's spout and handle structure are anatomically incorrect for a jebena
note: While the scene captures the warm atmosphere of a coffee ceremony, the design of the jebena and cups is inaccurate to Ethiopian tradition.
